subject: Error in library(NicheMapR) : there is no package called ‘NicheMapR’

messages.author: ca68732937e28fb3
messages.subject: Error in library(NicheMapR) : there is no package called ‘NicheMapR’
parts:
Good morning,

I've been through this several times but can't figure out the error. I've installed the package from the 'NicheMapR-master.zip' I downloaded from the Github site.

The problem comes when I run: library(NicheMapR)

It throws this error:

Error in library(NicheMapR) : there is no package called ‘NicheMapR’

If I let R Studio fill in the parentheses then the name NicheMapR-master is an option but it throws the same error:

Error in library(`NicheMapR-master`) : 
  there is no package called ‘NicheMapR-master’

I've tried removing the ' ' but no change...

I'm running R Studio with R 3.4.4

Thanks for the help. I'm very excited to analyze soil depth for my system!

Chris

messages.author: 9c7ab3c81d833137
messages.subject: Re: Error in library(NicheMapR) : there is no package called ‘NicheMapR’
parts:
Hi Chris,

Have you tried installing NicheMapR by using devtools? If you install this you can install the latest version of the software by using:

install_github("mrke/nichemapr")

I believe Mike's 2016 paper detailing the microclimate model provides all the code to install it this way. It can be found here: https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/abs/10.1111/ecog.02360 

Cheers,
Simon

messages.author: e46cb5dd353b7dfb
messages.subject: Re: Error in library(NicheMapR) : there is no package called ‘NicheMapR’
parts:
Hi Molly - R is case sensitive. You need: install_github("mrke/NicheMapR").

This version may not work right now - I'm in the middle of changing a couple of things.

If you install the latest release from https://github.com/mrke/NicheMapR/releases it will work.

All the best,
Mike

messages.author: 4fe662adc062e9c8
messages.subject: Re: Error in library(NicheMapR) : there is no package called ‘NicheMapR’
parts:
Hi Mike, 

I fixed it, it worked when I downloaded and installed NicheMapR 1.1.3 and not NicheMapR 1.1.4.... 
included reference code below for others who need help troubleshooting

#Rstudio
> install.packages("~/R/win-library/3.4/NicheMapR-1.1.4.zip", repos = NULL, type = "win.binary")
Installing package into ‘~/Documents/R/win-library/3.4’
(as ‘lib’ is unspecified)
> library(`NicheMapR-1.1.4`)
Error in library(`NicheMapR-1.1.4`) : 
  there is no package called ‘NicheMapR-1.1.4’
> install.packages("~/Downloads/NicheMapR_1.1.3.zip", repos = NULL, type = "win.binary")
Installing package into ‘~/Documents/R/win-library/3.4’
(as ‘lib’ is unspecified)
package ‘NicheMapR’ successfully unpacked and MD5 sums checked 
> library(NicheMapR) 
#package NicheMapR shows up as an available package now that it's successfully unpacked. 
>
